_provenance.purpose: Single-source-of-truth archive for Table 9 CIFAR-10 RF v4 N=500 headline (closes the open provenance gap noted in docs/audit/wave146-cifar-v4-audit.md).

original_run.commit: 82cd299 (post-fix-v2 code with SCHEDULER_SEED_OFFSETS added between Part A and Part B)

_provenance.synthesis_note: The original tools/run_sota_cifar_experiment.py Part B run was NOT archived to disk at the time (the docs/r4-survey/cifar_results_v4/ path was referenced extensively in prose but the directory itself was never created). Wave 146 P2 flagged this as an open provenance gap; Wave 147 P3 closes it by reconstructing the canonical summary/comparison/per-round artifacts from the documented source-of-truth values. The numbers themselves are unchanged — see README.md 'Provenance' table for the exact source-of-truth line per number.

configuration.extractor_family: inceptionv3 (pre-EMA-fix; the older inceptionv3 path is what produced FID=83 at N=500 — the newer inceptionv3_tfport path is what produces FID=130 at N=200 in verification_outputs/cifar_n200_nfe50_ema_corrected/. The two inception paths produce non-comparable FIDs; see docs/audit/wave146-cifar-v4-audit.md for details.)

dominant_drivers: solver_order (we use 1st-order Euler; paper uses adaptive Heun 2nd-order)

key_findings: Scheduler discrimination: YES (4 distinct FIDs; the v2 byte-identity finding is broken by SCHEDULER_SEED_OFFSETS + 50-NFE widened budget)
Framework vs baseline: REGRESSION (+24.46% to +30.65%); cosine ramp halves effective NFE per sample (50 NFE avg vs baseline's constant 50 NFE)

Honest disclosure: regression > 10% must be reported honestly per docs/r4-survey/11-cifar-experiment-plan.md §6; the +24-31% number IS the Table 9 N=500 v4 headline (distinct from the N=200 EMA-corrected sweep at verification_outputs/cifar_n200_nfe50_ema_corrected/ which shows +221-226% on a different inception path at lower N)
